name: deliberate
description: Two decision formats. `deliberate`: a domain-agnostic evidence harness - independent scouts, verified ledger, rival mechanisms, adversarial contest, silent vote, decision record with a kill criterion. `ldj`: AJ&Smart's 30-90 minute problem-first Lightning Decision Jam, verified procedure, no research required. Opposite entry points - LDJ starts from what holds us back, deliberate from what is true.
